texto:
If you have enough Biometrics or X-Genes you can recruit a character.
Create a team with recruited characters and participate in various missions. The more characters you recruit, the easier it will be to complete missions.

Each character is categorized by their Battle Type: Combat, Blast, Speed and Universal Types.
When attacking, if the damage displays in YELLOW, the Character’s type has an Advantage. If displayed in GRAY, the current type has a disadvantage against that specific type.

A Character’s Battle Type is shown on their icon. The Type Affinity in principle is similar to Rock, Paper, Scissors.

Purchase a Uniform from the Uniform List and equip them to your Characters.

When a Uniform is equipped:
▶Stats increase
▶Design Changes

texto:
When the Characters in your Team have a special relationship, it will activate a Team Bonus.

When a Team Bonus is activated:
▶Increased Stat Bonus
▶Use Co-op Play in Missions

Each hero has a unique Instinct.
There are 4 types of Instincts and they scale up with Character Rank and Levels.

Instincts inflict Instinct Damageto enemies in battle.
Landing basic attacks allows players to deal more damage based on their characters' Instinct Stats.
Players can defend against Instinct Damage only by using Instinct Abilities.
Instinct Stats are not affected by buffs or debuffs that affect basic stats.

The Details page displays Instinct stats based on percentage, such as Critical Rate and Dodge Rate, in relation to other players that have the same Total Instinct Stats as the player.
Percentage based Instinct Stats are more effective against players with less Total Instinct Stats and less effective against players with more Total Instinct Stats.

Characters each belong to certain factions.
Factions can change based on an equipped uniform, and they are broadly divided into Super Heroes, Super Villains, and Neutral.
Super Villains and Villains
Within a stage, Super Villains and Villains are considered separate factions.
Super Villains are powerful bosses.

texto:
Upgrade gear (up to +5) automatically by leveling up your character. Gear can be leveled up to +30 using material collected from missions.
Tap the material icon to start the mission.

Use additional ISO-8 as enhancement material to enhance the target ISO-8 up to +5 to gain higher stat increase. You can also enhance equipped ISO-8.
Additional ISO-8 can be collected from Dimension Mission.
If a specific ISO-8 has been enhanced to +5, you may combine 2 of the same type of ISO-8 to increase the ISO-8 rank. You may also combine equipped ISO-8. The highest rank for ISO-8 is 6 stars.

If you equip certain combinations of ISO-8, you will gain a Set Bonus. You may check which set bonus has been applied to your character from the ISO-8 Equip Page. Equipping ISO-8 according to the guide displayed on the page will allow you to gain a Set Bonus.
If you want to change to another set bonus, tap Change Set.

A 6★ ISO-8 enhanced to +5 can be used as material to awaken another 6★ ISO-8. Awakened ISO-8 gets additional stats. They can be awakened up to 6 times. A Set using awakened ISO-8 will have a much stronger Set Bonus.

Use 5 Cards of the same Rank as Material to upgrade the target card up to a maximum of Rank 6.
When upgraded, the Rank will increase and the quality and option stats may change.

Premium Cards can be crafted with 5 Mythic Cards and Card Crafting Cube as materials. Premium Cards can be crafted up to Level 6, and new stats will be added upon each time they're crafted.
The color of the ★ will change to one of the following: Red, Blue, Green. Additional stats will be acquired when the number of a certain color reaches a set number.
In addition, you can obtain bonus options by crafting up to a certain number of ★.

Use Celestial Essence as materials to enhance Artifacts up to +20.
Artifact's instinct stat increases when enhanced.
Dismantle artifacts to acquire Celestial Essence.

Artifact's enhance level can be transferred.

When overwriting an equipped artifact with a new one, the higher level can be transferred to the new artifact if the previous artifact's level is higher than the new artifact.

Enhance level can be transferred regardless of the artifact grade or type.

texto:
Celestial Essence is a key ingredient to enhance artifacts. Dismantle owned artifacts to acquire.
More Celestial Essence can be acquired when dismantling higher-grade artifacts.

Swords can be enchanted up to Lv. 6 using Enchantment Runes. Enchanting a Sword applies 1 of 6 Elements and a powerful effect. Swords that have been enchanted to max level can be Awakened to create Special Swords.

Enchantment Runes are a type of material used to enchant Swords and can be acquired by dismantling the Swords you own. You can obtain more Enchantment Runes the higher the level of the Sword you dismantle.

Obelisks, a type of Custom Gear, can be Enhanced to create better and higher-grade Custom Gears.
When the grade of your Custom Gear goes up as a result of Enhancement, it can get stat increases, option modifications,
or even new options, depending on the grade.
Each Custom Gear's first option will not change, but the second option onwards can change, with the outcomes being random.

C.T.P. with high stats can be acquired upon Reforging Super Success. Additional C.T.P. can be used to increase the super success rate.

texto:
Uru Amplification can be used to increase the stats of equipped Uru.
When you amplify Uru, all equipped Uru will attempt amplification. Any Uru that is successfully amplified will get bonus stats. Amplification can be attempted an unlimited number of times, as long as you have enough gold. The Uru that gets amplified is random.

Amplified Uru will go through amplification again, and has a chance of losing its amplification.

texto:
Use 2 same-grade Uru to combine. Uru of the same grade or a grade higher can be acquired randomly.
Combining 2 Uru of the same type will produce Uru of the same type.
There is a chance to acquire Odin's Blessing upon combining Mythic Enchanted Uru. Odin’s Blessing has higher stats than other Uru.

Use Mythic or higher Enchanted Uru and Eternal Flame as material to awaken Odin's Blessing.
You can obtain an Engraved Odin's Blessing or Odin's Glory of a higher effect value when awakening Odin's Blessing. If you equip it on a character's equipment, the character can additionally obtain an awakening effect.

You can enhance J.A.R.V.I.S. Chips using their exclusive J.A.R.V.I.S. Data
and J.A.R.V.I.S. Data Shards as materials.

Enhancing a J.A.R.V.I.S. Chip increases its stats.

You can change the options of a J.A.R.V.I.S. Chip using its exclusive J.A.R.V.I.S. Data as material.

A J.A.R.V.I.S. Chip's enhancement level is retained after its options are changed.
EX Chips have bonus effects. You can also change the type of an EX Chip's bonus effect by changing options.

Story is a game mode where you can experience the main story of the game.
There are two difficulty levels for Story mode: Normal and Ultimate.

Normal difficulty is suitable for all players, including beginners. You can use any character you own.
Ultimate difficulty is for seasoned players. You must use Tier-3 or Potential Transcended characters Lv. 70 or higher.

You can obtain various items such as Story Fragments, as well as upgrade materials such as Biometrics, Norn Stones, and Type Enhancement Kits.
Gather Story Fragments to craft chests containing special items.

Epic Quests follow the journeys of several different heroes.
As you play through the story-based quests, the protagonist character will get stronger.

When you begin an Epic Quest, you will receive the protagonist character.

texto:
Battle against enemies from different dimensions every day and acquire rewards in Dimension Mission.
Select desired difficulty to start the battle. More rewards are available at a higher difficulty.

Support Tokens can be acquired in Dimension Mission. A variety of items can be purchased with Support Tokens in the Support Shop.

In Dispatch Mission, you clear stages in a specific area and then dispatch characters to that area.
When progressing through a stage, three characters can fight at the same time, and there's no separate cooldown when tagging.

In areas where characters have been dispatched, supplies can be obtained at regular intervals without engaging in battle.
You can obtain more supplies if the total Combat Power of the dispatched characters is high or based on your VIP Level.
The more stages you clear in each area, the more characters you can dispatch.

In Dispatch Mission, you can earn Dispatch EXP by clearing stages to increase your Dispatch Level.
Increasing your Dispatch Level allows you to earn more supplies.

In Timeline Battle, you form teams of 3 and challenge other players.
You will be ranked depending on the points you earn, and can be either promoted or demoted.

In Timeline Battle, you can collect Glory Tokens. Glory Tokens can be used in the Timeline Shop to purchase Character Biometrics and other various rewards.

Alliance Battle is a mode where you can compete against other Alliances with Stage Clear Points.
Only players who are in an Alliance can participate.

Alliance Battle consists of Boss Battles and Relay Battles
When Boss Battle is unlocked, Normal, Extreme, and Legend difficulties are made available in that order.
When Relay Battle unlocks, Infinite Challenge mode becomes available.

Extreme mode unlocks when Normal mode is cleared.
Legend mode unlocks when you clear Extreme mode with 1,000,000 points or higher.

When you clear Extreme, Legend, and Infinite Challenge modes, Challenge mode becomes available.
*You can obtain a reward by reaching a certain score, and you can also set high scores.

Alliance Battle's mode and the day of the week decide the characters who can participate.
The daily requirements may ask for a certain character type, faction, race, or gender. Only the characters that meet the requirements of the day can participate.
*Characters who achieved the highest record in each mode are not allowed to participate in different [cortado]

texto:
Otherworld Battle is a mode where you can fight against other players.
You will form a team of 5 characters to fight an opponent's team.
Buffs can be applied to each participating character, and characters can be strategically deployed in different locations of your choosing.

Arena Points determine the league, and the league and ranking rewards will be available based on your record at the end of a season.

Warrior Mementos are available in Otherworld Battle. Warrior Mementos can be used to purchase battlefield buffs, enhancement items, and growth materials in the Otherworld Shop.

A season in Otherworld Battle lasts 8 weeks, after which it resets. During a season reset, all battlefield buffs you have will be reset as well.

Fight against powerful bosses in World Boss.
Create your own unique team of characters and fight against beings from across the galaxy with the help of your allies.

World Boss difficulty is divided into 6 different modes.
World Boss: Beginner is best for players who don't have much experience against World Bosses.
World Boss: Normal is best for players who have somewhat stronger characters and have some experience fighting world bosses.
World Boss: Ultimate is for players who have strengthened their characters to Tier-2 or higher.
World Boss: Legend is for advanced players who have strengthened their characters to Tier-3, Transcend Potential or higher.
World Boss: Legend+ is for advanced players who have strengthened their characters to Tier-4 or higher.
World Boss: Mythic is recommended for elite players who have advanced their Heroes to Tier-4 or higher and have mastered World Boss: Legend+.

Get Tier-2 Advancement Materials, Black Anti-Matter, Norn Stones of Chaos, material to evolve Mutants and Tier-3 Advancement materials like Titan's Record, Cosmic Cube Fragments, Essence of Dimension, Titan Component Packs, material to reforge C.T.P. like C.T.P. Reforging Core, Tier-4 Advancement materials like Carbonadium, and Life Seed, and materials to enhance J.A.R.V.I.S. like J.A.R.V.I.S. Data Shard from World Boss.

texto:
Multiverse Saga is story content that allows you to experience to journeys of specific characters.
You can enjoy battles by directly controlling the characters without reflecting the player's account and character growth status.

Multiverse Saga consists of Normal Story Pack and Hidden Story Pack.

Once you complete all the Normal Story Pack, you can proceed to the boss stage.
The boss stage consists of several stages, and a Skip function is available for stages that have been cleared.

Each story has its own dedicated characters and you can acquire Biometrics.

You can acquire Emblem Growth Materials by clearing the Multiverse Saga episodes.

Daredevil, controlled by the Dark Beast, creates Shadowland - a fortress where his law is the only law - above the remains of Hell’s Kitchen. As Daredevil grows increasingly violent, several Heroes must band together to stop the slaughter.
In Shadowland, Heroes must face and clear various battlefields to reach the top floor.

The Alliance Tournament will determine the best Alliance in the Multiverse.
The Alliance Battle is a scheduled competition among the Top 16 Alliances.

Cheer: Players that are not included in the Tournament will be able to Cheer on an Alliance of their choosing. The Player will get Rewards depending on the final rank of the chosen Alliance. The Alliance will get more rewards if more people cheer them on.

In Legendary Battle, relive famous scenes inspired by the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
Players can enjoy battle scenes from the movies and play in familiar locations with specific characters.

Legendary Battles can only be played with specific characters that fit the theme, and they can be played whether or not you have recruited them.

Clear stages and get various rewards. However, players will acquire bonus rewards depending on the Growth Score of the character they own.

Alliance Conquest is a game mode where alliances compete against one another.
Three Alliances fight against one another and proceed in the following order.

1. SELECT REGION
Once a Conquest begins, an Alliance can attack a region bordering their starting point.
Each region will be defended and must be cleared for it to be seized.
Once a region has been successfully seized, the Alliance will get Conquest Points.

2. BATTLE
Select the Defending Troops to attack a particular region.
Battles will proceed automatically. Once deployed, a character cannot be used again until the next reset.
Once a region is successfully seized, the characters used for the attack will be stationed there for defense.
Characters that are defending a region cannot be used to attack other regions.

3. PROTECTED REGIONS

Once a region has been seized, it becomes a protected region.
Once a region is protected, it cannot be attacked or seized by another Alliance until the protection is removed.

Tip: Once the protection is removed, regions can be taken by attacking. Alliances can earn additional conquest points according to the region's conquest duration.

4. BATTLE END
Once a conquest has ended, ranks will be determined by the number of conquest points an Alliance has.
Rewards are determined by the rank of the Alliance.

texto:
Team up with characters from different dimensions to defeat the Giant Boss in Giant Boss Raid.

3 players can enter at once, and the battle can proceed with 1 or 2 players as well.
The boss's difficulty increases when more players participate, also providing more rewards.

Acquire Type Enhancement Kits, Tier-4 Advancement Materials like the Book of the Vishanti, and Soul of the Faltine in Giant Boss Raid.
The bosses change daily, providing different rewards for each.

Use Boost Points in the Lobby to increase the reward count.
Additional rewards equivalent to the set reward count can be acquired upon victory.
Strengthen a randomly selected Bonus Character for each battle to increase your chance to acquire rewards.

All agents battle against a number of enemies using characters with the same Tier, Rank, Gear, ISO-8, Comic Card settings in the World Event.

The World Event will be available at a set time every day, and available characters will be selected randomly when the event starts.

All participants can acquire battle grade and score based on the battle results.

Individual Reward can be acquired based on your best score during the event period,
and World Reward can be acquired based on average battle grade of all participants when the event ends.

Timeline Survival is content that allows you to enter the timeline to defeat villains and acquire rewards for defeating all bosses in the current timeline.

Up to three characters can enter simultaneously during a stage, and there are no separate cooldowns for tagging.

Each time you enter the timeline, the location where the boss appears will be different. Before going into the boss stage, you can interact with various locations such as Hero Admin Office, Shops, Rewards, and Landmarks to increase the combat power of participating characters.

Timeline Survival can be accessed for the duration of the event. At the end of the event, HP, survival effects, and TVA tokens on characters are reset.

The Dimension Rift is a cooperative mode where you can team up with friends or Alliance members to battle and earn rewards.

To open higher-tier Dimension Rifts, you must use Dimension Rift Summon Stones obtained from Dimension Rifts.
The required summon stone grade depends on the tier of the Dimension Rift being opened, with higher tiers offering greater rewards.

Opened Dimension Rifts can be shared with friends and Alliance members, allowing you to challenge them together.
Successfully clearing a Dimension Rift increases its Completion Progress. Completion Progress also increases when friends or Alliance members successfully clear it.

Successfully clearing a Dimension Rift grants Clear Rewards and unlocks higher difficulty levels.
Once the Dimension Rift's Completion Progress reaches 100%, participants with at least 1 Completion Progress Point or those who used a participation attempt can earn Completion Rewards by clearing stages.
The participant with the highest Completion Progress will be selected as MVP and receive the MVP Reward.

texto:
Zombie Survival is a mode where you have to survive against oncoming zombies for a set amount of time.

In Zombie Survival, there are skill restrictions, stage hazards, character restrictions and zombie enhancements.
Skill restrictions prevent you from using the skill in that slot.
Stage hazards apply additional effects to levels.
Character restrictions prevent you from deploying certain character types.
Zombie enhancements increase the zombies' ATK, DEF, and HP as the level increases.
*Skill restrictions, stage hazards, and character restrictions will change every week.

You can obtain rewards by completing Zombie Survival Challenges and competing for ranks in Zombie Survival.

You can obtain Eternal Flames and Zombie Survival Tokens by completing Zombie Survival Challenges, which are exclusive to Zombie Survival.

Obtain rewards by competing for ranks against up to 50 players that change each week, and you will receive rewards based on your rank.
You will be ranked by the highest score you achieve. Higher levels provide higher scores.
Points are awarded for each zombie you eliminate, and players who eliminate more will earn more points and rank higher than other players on the same level.

texto:
Team Battle Arena is a game mode in which you engage in tactical combat with other players.

You can build up to 5 teams, each made of 3 characters, using Hero Cost, and use them to battle against other players' teams.

Your league is determined based on the amount of Arena Points you earn, and at the end of the season, you'll receive various rewards based on your league and final rank.

Additionally, you can obtain Arena Tokens in Team Battle Arena. You can exchange Arena Tokens in the Arena Shop for various rewards such as enhancement items and growth materials.
